name: Raleigh Digital Connectors
org: City of Raleigh, Digital Impact Unit
what_you_do: Meet each week to learn about the digital divide, build leadership skills, explore tech careers, and help Raleigh residents use technology. You do at least 10 hours of service.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12 who live in the City of Raleigh.
pay_detail: A stipend, plus a free laptop when you finish. The page does not state the stipend amount.
duration: Several months of weekly meetings, with no more than four unexcused absences.
deadline_text: Applications for the Fall 2026 group are closed. The page says an interest form for the Fall 2027 group opens in January 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form on the Digital Impact Programs page when it opens in January 2027. The form does not promise a spot.
notes: After Digital Connectors, alumni can join Raleigh Digital Ambassadors: a 10 month program with 45 service hours and a stipend, where you help residents at events like Advice About Your Device.
